FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our services
FAQ.q1: How does the project process work?
FAQ.a1: Choose your service, submit your project requirements, and place your order. Our team will review your request, then send you a detailed quote including pricing, timeline, and project scope before work begins.
FAQ.q2: How are pricing and timelines determined?
FAQ.a2: Every project is reviewed individually based on complexity, features, and delivery expectations. After reviewing your requirements, we provide a final price, estimated timeline, deposit amount, and project plan.
FAQ.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQ.a3: We currently accept secure cryptocurrency payments including USDT TRC20. Deposit and remaining payment instructions are sent after project review and approval.
FAQ.q4: Can I track my project progress?
FAQ.a4: Yes. Every client receives a unique Order ID and access to real-time order tracking, project updates, status changes, file delivery, and direct communication with our team.
FAQ.q5: Do you offer revisions and support?
FAQ.a5: Yes. Revision support is included to ensure the final result meets the agreed project scope and quality standards. Additional support is also available after delivery if needed.
FAQ.q6: Is my information and project kept private?
FAQ.a6: Absolutely. All client information, files, and project details are handled confidentially. Your data is never shared with third parties.
